explanation: I read the eigenvalue API in Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Spectrum.lean. It has eigenvalues_antitone, exists_eigenvalues_eq, card_filter_eigenvalues_eq, charpoly_eq, sort_roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues and eigenvalues_eq_eigenvalues_iff. None of these says that an antitone list μ with an orthonormal eigenbasis w (S (w i) = μ i • w i) must equal hS.eigenvalues hn. I also grepped for Antitone/eigenvalues uniqueness lemmas and found only eigenvalues₀_antitone in the Matrix spectrum file. A derivation through the characteristic polynomial would need a toMatrix computation and a sorting argument, which is more than two short lines.
